column7: 2026-11-04: {WW} week token must match finance's Excel WEEKNUM(date, 2): weeks start Monday, week 1 = week containing Jan 1 (NOT ISO 8601). Chosen so output matches finance spreadsheets. {DDD} day-of-year token (zero-padded to 3) is being added first, separately, for review; WW builds on it.
2026-11-04: {WW} implemented in src/index.js via shared dayOfYear helper; formula floor((doy-1+jan1Monday0)/7)+1; tests include Jan 1 2021 (Fri) => 01 where ISO would give 53
